name: error handler
description: Error workflow: log a PII-free incident row and send one alert email.

parameters.content:
## error handler
Every workflow in this project sets this one as its error workflow.

1. **Error Trigger** receives workflow + execution metadata.
2. `code/src/incident.js` keeps ids, node name, error name and a masked, 300-char error message. No email body, subject, sender or item data.
3. Row goes to `incident_log`; one alert email goes out.
If this workflow itself fails, n8n only keeps the failed execution (no second alert).
